premises: Pack cementation aluminizing can produce a sub-micrometer aluminide layer on refractory alloys.
The aluminide layer converts into a continuous, dense, and adherent Al2O3 scale upon high-temperature oxidation.
The Al2O3 scale substantially limits oxygen ingress and enhances oxidation resistance.
The treatment and scale do not degrade the alloy's room-temperature ductility and high-temperature yield strength.
